name: Grimtotem tribe
summary: Across Kalimdor, the Grimtotem tribe raids settlements and keeps apart from Thrall's Horde. Dark hides and fierce warpaint mark them, and they seek to drive foreign races from Kalimdor and reclaim ancestral lands by any means. Their matriarch, Elder Crone Magatha Grimtotem, resides atop Thunder Bluff while her kin raid across the continent.

sections.title: A Tribe Apart
sections.body:
Grimtotem warriors train for ruthless combat rather than the patient harmony of the Great Hunt. They believe Kalimdor belongs only to the tauren. Their peaceful cousins honor the Earth Mother with reverence, but the Grimtotem disdain the other races settled on their ancient lands.

Cairne Bloodhoof welcomed them into Thunder Bluff, hoping to unite all tauren. Yet the Grimtotem remain the only major tribe never to formally join Thrall's Horde. They keep apart and pursue a violent cause.

sections.title: Wildland Aggressors
sections.body:
Beyond Thunder Bluff's watch, Grimtotem hostility turns to violence. In Stonetalon Mountains, they butcher local settlements and threaten Horde supply outposts. Across the mesas of Thousand Needles, they gather around Darkcloud Pinnacle, menace Freewind Post, and plot to seize the canyon.

Feralas is no safer. They attack Horde travelers, Alliance caravans, and fellow tauren without hesitation. Horde garrisons at Sun Rock Retreat and Camp Mojache regularly post bounties and send warriors to cut down these violent outcasts.

sections.title: Shadows and Apothecaries
sections.body: Magatha Grimtotem's spiritual counsel conceals a web of intrigue. The Elder Crone ardently supports the tauren's controversial ties with the Forsaken. In public, she says she wants to heal the undead. In secret, she seeks toxic plagues and Highborne artifacts. In Thousand Needles, scouts from Freewind Post intercept guarded letters between cloaked couriers and Grimtotem chieftains in Darkcloud Pinnacle.

faq.q: Why are the Grimtotem hostile if their leader lives in Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: The Grimtotem never formally joined the Horde. Cairne Bloodhoof tolerates Magatha Grimtotem on Thunder Bluff's high mesas, hoping to keep peace among the tauren. Yet the tribe's roaming warriors reject outside diplomacy. In Stonetalon, Thousand Needles, and Feralas, they attack anyone who trespasses on ancestral territory, including other tauren.

faq.q: How can you tell a Grimtotem apart from other tauren?
faq.answer: Grimtotem tauren almost always have pitch-black fur. They paint sharp patterns in stark white, deep red, or blue across their bodies and faces.

Magatha Grimtotem, the Elder Crone, rules the tribe as a powerful shaman on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. She took power after marrying the previous chieftain. He died shortly afterward in an unexplained climbing mishap.

The Grimtotem seek to purge Kalimdor of foreign races they consider lesser, including orcs, humans, and night elves. They also seek to reclaim all ancestral tauren lands. Unlike Cairne's people, they believe these lands should be taken through force, deception, and elemental dominion.

faq.q: Why does Magatha Grimtotem work with the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Magatha publicly says she champions the Forsaken because tauren shamanism and earth wisdom may cure their affliction and restore their humanity.

angles.text: The Grimtotem bring open shame to the Bloodhoof and other tribes. Cairne gives them shelter in Thunder Bluff for tauren unity, but their warmongering threatens to tear that unity apart.
Their black hides do not make the Grimtotem allies. Across Kalimdor's barrens, mountains, and marshes, their warriors ambush Horde scouts on sight.
The Grimtotem despise all who cross into Kalimdor. They attack Alliance traders and night elf enclaves without distinction.
Magatha Grimtotem is one of the few tauren leaders in Thunder Bluff who openly courts the Forsaken. She arranges research into exotic plagues with Royal Apothecary Society specialists.
